name: 43616 · Oregon, OH
findings: ZIP 43616 (Oregon) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43616 (Oregon) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
